description.en: Orchestrator-preset workflows. The shipped workflow-orchestrator preset (only it can see the tools) turns a one-off request into a node graph and runs it: each robot keeps one session for the whole run in its workspace under the normal worker preset, compacting that session's history before every later entry and working without approval prompts; gate nodes pause on the normal approval dialog; gate-free runs keep scheduling sessions in the background after the tool call returns, so nothing blocks the orchestrator's turn. Definitions may contain loops, bounded by maxSteps and per-node maxVisits. A read-only sidebar page draws each persisted run as a vertical git-like graph of capsules: cross-row and loop edges use nested side lanes (inner spans stay close, outer spans wrap around them) so they never cross, every edge carries a mid-path arrow, and a cycle reads as the two opposite arrows joining the same nodes, duplicate rules to the same target merge into one line, visited nodes show ×N, and nodes the run never reached stay gray. Robot capsules also show that robot's preset avatar (from the Buka Robots service), and every capsule is labelled with the creator-written step summary, which also becomes the title of the detail panel (the node id stays as a small code label); the panel below shows the executor and the node configuration, plus one tab per execution with that run's rendered task, deliverable, status, time and duration, the session id with an open-session action, and history-compacted markers on repeated entries (robot sessions are titled with the run goal and robot name, so the sidebar shows which run and robot each conversation belongs to); structured routing fields stay in the run record (the output tab shows the deliverable text, never a key/value table or raw JSON), the end node shows the run's final deliverable with a link back to the execution that produced it, and the legend footer stays pinned to the page bottom. Every transition is an edge with a creator-written name and prompt: one start node carries the first robot prompt on its outgoing edge, every edge entering a robot node carries the prompt for that entry, and gate branches use the same edge shape. Hovering an edge on the run page turns it into a slightly thicker solid line, dims the other edges, and pins a small chip with only its name (never its condition or prompt) beside the middle of the rail instead of following the cursor, so a loop can send the same robot node back with different instructions without adding a second fix node. A report node that ends without a JSON result is asked again inside the same session (bounded retries) before the node may fail. Definition snapshots, run state, events and node results are persisted for review. Runs are numbered in creation order (#N); auto-archive can be configured per hour on the page — runs are archived after 1 day and deleted after 7 days by default, archived runs are hidden from the default list, and records past the delete time are removed.
description.zh-cn: 由编排 preset 创建的一次性工作流：随插件发布的 workflow-orchestrator preset 是唯一能看到工具入口的 preset，它把一次性需求变成节点图并启动；同一个机器人在一次运行里共用一个会话：首次进入时新开，之后每次进入都先 compact 压缩历史、再把新的边 prompt 发进同一会话（普通工作 preset）、不弹审批；门禁节点弹原生审批框，拒绝后可跳转其他节点或终止；不含门禁的运行在工具返回后继续在后台调度节点会话，不占编排器会话的 turn。定义里允许循环，由 maxSteps 与节点的 maxVisits 兜底。侧边栏「工作流」页面只负责观测：把每次运行画成类似 git log 的纵向节点图，跨行与循环边走右侧竖线 lane、内层靠里外层包在外面，嵌套分层不交叉，每条连线在中段带方向箭头，循环由同一对节点的两个相反箭头围成，指向同一目标的多条规则合并成一条线，重复进入的节点标 ×N，本次运行没走到的节点显示为灰色虚线胶囊；机器人节点的胶囊前还会显示该机器人的预设头像（来自 Buka Robots 服务），胶囊用创建者写的步骤概要作为标签，点开后的节点标题也是这句步骤概要（节点 id 只作标题旁的小标签）；右侧再展示执行人、节点配置，按「第几次执行」的 Tab 查看那一次的任务信息、输出结果、状态 / 时间 / 时长；机器人节点的详情固定展示该机器人的会话 id 和「打开会话」入口，机器人会话按「运行目标 · 机器人」命名，侧边栏里能直接认出是哪次运行的哪段对话；重复进入的执行标出「已压缩历史」，输出结果展示交付物正文，路由用的结果字段留在运行记录里、不在页面上按 key/value 铺开，也不展示原始 JSON；Tab 底部左侧是上一步、右侧是下一步，可以沿运行记录两个方向走（点击即跳转）；终止节点展示这次运行的最终交付物（最后一次有正文的机器人执行）并可点回那次执行；底部图例 footer 固定在页面底部，不随内容滚走。每条转移都是一条边，创建者给边写名字和 prompt：唯一的开始节点通过出边定义第一个机器人节点的 prompt，每个进入机器人节点的边都带这次进入要用的 prompt，门禁分支也使用同样的边对象；悬停连线会把它变成实线、略粗一点并压暗其余连线，名字以小标签钉在线中段右侧（不跟着鼠标跑），只显示名字（不展示条件 / 提示词），所以循环可以把同一个机器人节点原样打回、只换边上的指令，不需要再建一个修复节点。report 节点结束时没有交回 JSON 时，插件会在同一个会话里要求它按格式重新回复（有次数上限），仍没有结果节点才失败。定义快照、运行状态、事件与节点结果都会落盘，方便回看。运行按创建顺序编号（#N）；自动归档可在页面按小时配置，默认超过 1 天归档、超过 7 天删除，已归档运行从默认列表隐藏、超过删除时间后记录被删除。
